title: feat: allow Takax62 to publish community models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds GitHub user ID `184364250` (`Takax62`) to the community model publisher allowlist.
- Keeps the change limited to the shared allowlist.

Fixes #12684

gist.headline: One more gardener
gist.blurb: Takax62 now has the keys to the community-model garden. The shared allowlist grew by one very intentional line.
gist.summary: Added GitHub user ID 184364250 (Takax62) to the shared community model publisher allowlist.
gist.impact: Takax62 can now publish community models for the wider pollinations.ai ecosystem to use.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Takax62 as a welcomed new garden steward through a glowing access-key or permit beside a code-plant nursery. Polli should be warmly helping open the garden gate, with model seeds and small labeled pots representing community models.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy garden-gate scene where Polli welcomes a new community-model gardener into a nursery of glowing code-plants, handing them a small lime green (#ecf874) access key beside pots labeled "MODELS" in simple pixel text. Polli is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny gardener hat and shares the frame with seedlings, flowers, and a retro terminal. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
